description: This PHP source file manages AJAX interactions for the Revive Adserver, including functions for expanding/collapsing UI rows and session management, as well as generating and caching JavaScript code for AJAX functionality.

classes.name: xajaxResponse
classes.description: Class for creating AJAX response objects to manipulate client-side DOM elements and show alerts.

methods.name: expandOSURow
methods.description: Expands a UI row identified by $id, displaying audit table data and toggling visibility of expand/collapse icons.

methods.name: collapseOSURow
methods.description: Collapses a UI row identified by $id, hiding audit table data and toggling visibility of expand/collapse icons.

methods.name: sessionExpired
methods.description: Alerts the user that their session has expired.
